input_scope: NASA FIRMS archive, MODIS Collection 6.1 and VIIRS S-NPP 375 m, historical positive thermal anomaly records
type_filter: FIRMS type=0 (presumed vegetation fire); all raw records counted in source metadata; agricultural and managed burning may remain
notes: Zero archive records on a UTC date do not establish satellite coverage or absence of fire.
Two sensors being positive in the same UTC date and 10-km cell is not a time-matched concordant detection or a measure of accuracy.
Source type=0 denotes presumed vegetation fire, which may include agricultural or managed burning and can contain classification errors.
Archive observational comparisons have not been normalized for overpass opportunities or sensor sensitivity.
1-degree spatial summaries allocate 10-km grid cell-days to approximate cell-centroid lat/lon bins; these are not counts of individual fires or burned area.
Historical VIIRS S-NPP platform anomalies in July 2024 warrant separate interpretation; other zero-record days are not automatically outages.
